items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Background The Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architecture has become a popular model-parameter-scale-up technique. Typically, one MoE layer consists of a router (often parameterized as one single Linear layer) and a group of experts (for transformer-based models, each expert is one feedforward layer).
